yahoo.snippet: Kotlin (/ ˈkɒtlɪn /) [3] is a cross-platform, statically typed, general-purpose high-level programming language with type inference. Kotlin is designed to interoperate fully with Java, and the Java virtual machine (JVM) version of Kotlin 's standard library depends on the Java Class Library.

brave.snippet: For some applications, it may be more convenient to have the least integer a such that n ≤ a², or in other words the ceiling of the exact square root of n. For positive n, this can be computed using a = 1 + isqrt(n - 1) .
